registration.entry: add "traceScoreChips.spec.js" to the Traces group run_files

rationale: No existing E2E spec covers score chips. traceGenAiParts.spec.js exercises the same LLM-span + sidebar navigation but asserts GenAI v5 `parts` rendering, not evaluator score chips; traceDetails.spec.js covers generic trace-detail actions. The score chips are a distinct feature (a new component wired into TraceDetailsSidebar), and run-context explicitly designates spec_path Traces/traceScoreChips.spec.js, so a new spec in the Traces area (with @traces tags) is the least-duplicative fit. The Vitest unit specs (TraceScoreChips.spec.ts, useTraceScoreChips.spec.ts) already cover component-level overflow/formatting and do NOT count as E2E coverage. The broader diff (LLM provider settings, experiment detail outcome cards) is a separate feature area and is intentionally out of scope for this single-feature spec.
